contradictions.source: τί δέ με ὑπερορᾷ ἔφη, μηδὲ ὑπερφρονεῖν αὐτοῦ;
contradictions.english: But why does he despise me, he said, and not even disdain him?
contradictions.why: The English translates 'not even disdain him' (referring to the king) instead of 'not even disdain me' (referring to himself).
